name: api-navigation-fit
goal: Every catalog category remains clickable beside Search and Settings at all compact widths after APIs extends the shared navigation.

evidence: The API insertion expands compact navigation from seven to eight links. The complete P4 Desktop browser run records Models clicks intercepted by the fixed Search icon at 768, 390 and 320 px. The prior CSS reserves the unused eighth grid cell only implicitly; all other existing width assertions are retained.

The standard ui-search-fit matrix checked viewport/nav clipping and search versus revision fields, then timed out clicking Models. Extend its existing fits assertion to reject category/search bounding-box overlap at every declared width and search state. The stale seven-category matrices share an explicit test-owned ordered inventory; ordinary browser verification retains every interaction and overflow assertion.
